entries.music_theory_en: reverberation (artificial or natural room reflections adding a decaying tail after the direct sound)
entries.plain_ko: 소리 뒤에 울림 여운이 남아 공간감이 느껴지는 리버브 효과
entries.plain_en: an echoing tail that makes the sound feel like it is in a room or hall

entries.music_theory_en: light chorus effect (subtle pitch/time-modulated doubling for gentle width and shimmer)
entries.plain_ko: 소리가 은은하게 겹쳐 살짝 넓고 일렁이게 들리는 옅은 코러스 효과
entries.plain_en: a subtle doubling effect that makes the sound gently wider and shimmery
entries.llm_prompt: subtle chorus effect, gentle stereo shimmer

entries.music_theory_en: plate reverb (metal-plate-based artificial reverberation, dense smooth tail with fast onset)
entries.plain_ko: 잔향이 매끈하고 촘촘하게 퍼지는 스튜디오풍 리버브
entries.plain_en: a smooth, dense studio reverb with a silky tail

entries.music_theory_en: chorus effect applied (modulated short-delay doubling creating width and slight detune shimmer)
entries.plain_ko: 코러스 이펙트가 걸려 소리가 겹쳐 넓고 살짝 일렁이는 느낌
entries.plain_en: processed with a chorus effect so the sound feels doubled and wider

entries.music_theory_en: dynamic range compression (attenuating peaks to even out loudness and add density/punch)
entries.plain_ko: 큰 소리와 작은 소리 차이를 눌러 고르고 단단하게 만드는 컴프레션
entries.plain_en: evening out loud and quiet parts so the sound feels tight and consistent

entries.music_theory_en: delay (discrete time-shifted echo repeats, often tempo-synced)
entries.plain_ko: 소리가 메아리처럼 일정 간격으로 반복되는 딜레이 효과
entries.plain_en: distinct echo repeats trailing after the sound

entries.music_theory_en: overdriven (soft-clipping saturation from a pushed amp/circuit, warm harmonic distortion)
entries.plain_ko: 앰프를 세게 밀어붙인 듯 소리가 따뜻하게 지글지글 찌그러진 상태
entries.plain_en: pushed into a warm, gritty crunch like a cranked amp

entries.music_theory_en: close-miking (microphone placed very near the source; dry, detailed, intimate capture with proximity bass boost)
entries.plain_ko: 마이크를 바짝 대고 녹음한 듯 숨결까지 들리는 가깝고 또렷한 소리
entries.plain_en: recorded with the mic very close, so it sounds intimate and detailed

entries.music_theory_en: room reverb (short natural-room reverberation, modest early reflections, realistic small-space ambience)
entries.plain_ko: 작은 방에서 울리는 듯 짧고 자연스러운 잔향
entries.plain_en: a short, natural echo like being in a normal room

entries.music_theory_en: processed (audibly treated with studio effects/signal processing rather than left natural)
entries.plain_ko: 이펙트를 거쳐 자연음이 아닌 가공된 느낌이 나는 소리
entries.plain_en: clearly treated with studio effects rather than sounding natural

entries.music_theory_en: chorus effect (modulated short delays layered with the dry signal, creating ensemble-like width and shimmer)
entries.plain_ko: 한 소리가 여러 명이 함께 연주하는 것처럼 넓고 일렁이게 들리는 코러스 이펙트
entries.plain_en: an effect that makes one sound feel like several playing together, wide and shimmering

entries.music_theory_en: vinyl crackle (surface-noise pops and crackles of a vinyl record, used as lo-fi texture)
entries.plain_ko: LP판을 틀 때 나는 지직거리는 잡음 질감
entries.plain_en: the crackling, popping noise of an old vinyl record

entries.music_theory_en: hall reverb (long concert-hall-style reverberation with slow diffuse decay)
entries.plain_ko: 큰 공연장에서 울리는 듯 길고 웅장하게 퍼지는 잔향
entries.plain_en: a long, grand echo like being in a concert hall

entries.music_theory_en: high-fidelity (full-bandwidth, low-noise, low-distortion reproduction; clean modern production quality)
entries.plain_ko: 잡음 없이 맑고 세밀한, 음질이 아주 좋은 소리
entries.plain_en: very clean, detailed, high-quality sound with no noise

entries.music_theory_en: overdrive (soft-clipping gain-stage saturation, warm crunchy harmonic distortion)
entries.plain_ko: 기타 앰프를 세게 튼 듯 따뜻하게 찌그러지는 오버드라이브
entries.plain_en: a warm, crunchy distortion like a cranked guitar amp

entries.music_theory_en: proximity (perceived closeness of a source; often proximity effect — bass boost from close directional miking)
entries.plain_ko: 소리가 귀 바로 앞에 있는 것처럼 가깝고 밀착되게 들리는 느낌
entries.plain_en: the sound feels very close and intimate, right next to your ear
entries.llm_prompt: close intimate presence, upfront in the mix

entries.music_theory_en: subtle chorus (low-depth/low-mix chorus modulation adding faint width without obvious warble)
entries.plain_ko: 티 나지 않을 만큼 살짝만 걸어 은은하게 넓어지는 코러스
entries.plain_en: a barely noticeable chorus that adds faint width and shimmer

entries.music_theory_en: pitch correction (automatic retuning of vocal/instrument pitch to the scale; Auto-Tune-style processing)
entries.plain_ko: 목소리 음정을 기계로 정확히 맞춘, 매끈하거나 로봇 같은 보정 효과
entries.plain_en: vocals digitally tuned to perfect pitch, smooth or robotic sounding

entries.music_theory_en: muffled (high frequencies attenuated, as if heard through a barrier; dull low-passed timbre)
entries.plain_ko: 이불이나 벽 너머로 듣는 것처럼 먹먹하고 둔한 소리
entries.plain_en: dull and smothered, like hearing music through a wall

entries.music_theory_en: long reverb (extended decay-time reverberation, washy sustained tail)
entries.plain_ko: 여운이 오래도록 길게 남아 퍼지는 잔향
entries.plain_en: an echo tail that lingers for a long time
entries.llm_prompt: long reverb tail, washy sustained ambience

entries.music_theory_en: wah (sweeping band-pass/resonant filter effect, e.g. wah-wah pedal, vowel-like "wah" sweep)
entries.plain_ko: 기타 소리가 '와우와우' 하고 입을 여닫듯 변하는 와우 페달 효과
entries.plain_en: a "wah-wah" sweeping effect that makes the sound open and close like a mouth
entries.llm_prompt: wah-wah filter sweep, funky vowel tone

entries.music_theory_en: stereo image (perceived left-right placement and width of sources in the stereo field)
entries.plain_ko: 소리들이 좌우로 어떻게 배치되고 얼마나 넓게 퍼지는지의 공간 배치감
entries.plain_en: how the sounds are spread and placed between the left and right speakers
entries.llm_prompt: wide stereo image, clear left-right placement

entries.music_theory_en: distortion (hard-clipping nonlinear saturation adding aggressive harmonics and grit)
entries.plain_ko: 소리가 거칠고 강하게 찌그러지는 디스토션
entries.plain_en: an aggressive, gritty crunch that roughens the sound

entries.music_theory_en: chorus effect (fragment: "...and chorus", listed alongside other effects; modulated doubling for width)
entries.plain_ko: 다른 이펙트와 함께 코러스도 걸렸다는 뜻의 표현 조각
entries.plain_en: a phrase fragment meaning a chorus effect is also applied

entries.music_theory_en: sidechain compression (ducking one signal — often pads/bass — in rhythm with another, typically the kick; pumping effect)
entries.plain_ko: 킥 드럼에 맞춰 다른 소리가 숨 쉬듯 눌렸다 커지는 펌핑 효과
entries.plain_en: the music "pumps" in and out in time with the kick drum

entries.music_theory_en: short reverb (brief decay-time reverberation adding subtle space without wash)
entries.plain_ko: 여운이 짧게 끊겨 살짝만 공간감을 주는 잔향
entries.plain_en: a quick, tight echo that adds a hint of space

entries.music_theory_en: feedback swell (controlled amplifier feedback rising gradually into a sustained singing tone)
entries.plain_ko: 기타 피드백이 서서히 커지며 길게 우는 듯 차오르는 소리
entries.plain_en: a guitar feedback note that slowly swells into a sustained wail
entries.llm_prompt: guitar feedback swell, rising sustained wail

entries.music_theory_en: EQ / equalization (boosting or cutting specific frequency bands to shape tone)
entries.plain_ko: 저음·고음 같은 특정 음역을 키우거나 줄여 음색을 다듬는 이퀄라이저
entries.plain_en: adjusting bass, mids, and treble to shape the tone

entries.music_theory_en: in the mix (describing an element's placement/level within the overall mix balance)
entries.plain_ko: 전체 사운드 안에서 그 소리가 어디쯤에 어느 크기로 자리하는지를 말하는 표현
entries.plain_en: describing where a sound sits in the overall balance of the track

entries.music_theory_en: signal processing (application of effects/dynamics/EQ treatment to a sound)
entries.plain_ko: 소리에 이펙트나 보정을 입히는 가공 작업 전반
entries.plain_en: the studio treatment and effects applied to a sound

entries.music_theory_en: mechanical (machine-like, rigidly quantized or robotic character in timbre/performance)
entries.plain_ko: 기계가 내는 듯 딱딱하고 규칙적인 느낌의 소리
entries.plain_en: stiff and machine-like, robotic in feel

entries.music_theory_en: sound effect (non-musical SFX element layered into the track, e.g. ambience, hits, foley)
entries.plain_ko: 음악 사이에 들어간 효과음
entries.plain_en: a non-musical sound (like ambience or a hit) added to the track

entries.music_theory_en: foley (recorded real-world everyday sounds — footsteps, rustles, objects — used as texture)
entries.plain_ko: 발소리·부스럭거림 같은 실제 생활 소음을 녹음해 넣은 효과음
entries.plain_en: recorded everyday real-world noises (footsteps, rustling) used as texture

entries.music_theory_en: sits forward (mixed prominently up front, louder/drier so it feels close to the listener)
entries.plain_ko: 그 소리가 믹스에서 앞으로 나와 또렷하게 들리는 상태
entries.plain_en: the sound is placed up front in the mix, close and prominent
entries.llm_prompt: vocals sit forward, upfront and present

entries.music_theory_en: forward in the mix (element placed prominently at the front of the mix depth-wise)
entries.plain_ko: 믹스에서 앞쪽에 배치되어 도드라지게 들리는 것
entries.plain_en: placed prominently at the front of the sound picture
entries.llm_prompt: forward in the mix, prominent and present

entries.music_theory_en: white noise (broadband noise with equal energy per frequency; hissing texture, common in risers/sweeps)
entries.plain_ko: 라디오 빈 채널처럼 '쉬-' 하는 고른 잡음 소리
entries.plain_en: a steady "shhh" hiss like radio static

entries.music_theory_en: sweep (gradual frequency/filter movement across the spectrum, often as a transition effect)
entries.plain_ko: 소리가 낮은 데서 높은 데로(또는 반대로) 쓸어 올라가듯 변하는 효과
entries.plain_en: a sound gliding upward or downward across the frequency range

entries.music_theory_en: record scratch (turntable vinyl scratch sound, DJ-style rhythmic friction effect)
entries.plain_ko: DJ가 LP판을 손으로 긁을 때 나는 '직직' 스크래치 소리
entries.plain_en: the "zig-zig" sound of a DJ scratching a vinyl record

entries.music_theory_en: centered in the mix (panned to the stereo center, anchoring the element in the middle)
entries.plain_ko: 그 소리가 좌우 치우침 없이 한가운데에서 들리는 것
entries.plain_en: the sound comes from the exact middle, not left or right
entries.llm_prompt: centered in the mix, anchored middle placement

entries.music_theory_en: tape hiss (high-frequency noise floor of analog magnetic tape, vintage lo-fi texture)
entries.plain_ko: 옛날 카세트테이프에서 나는 '스-' 하는 배경 잡음
entries.plain_en: the faint background hiss of an old cassette tape
entries.llm_prompt: tape hiss, vintage analog noise floor

entries.music_theory_en: tremolo effect (periodic amplitude modulation, volume pulsing at a steady rate)
entries.plain_ko: 소리 크기가 일정하게 떨리듯 커졌다 작아졌다 하는 트레몰로 효과
entries.plain_en: the volume pulses rhythmically, like the sound is trembling

entries.music_theory_en: riser (rising sweep/noise build-up used to create tension before a drop or section change)
entries.plain_ko: 하이라이트 직전에 긴장감을 끌어올리며 치솟는 상승 효과음
entries.plain_en: a rising whoosh that builds tension right before a big moment
entries.llm_prompt: riser build-up, tension sweep into the drop

entries.music_theory_en: polished production (refined commercial-grade mixing/mastering; clean, balanced, radio-ready sound)
entries.plain_ko: 잡티 없이 매끈하게 다듬어진 상업 음반 수준의 완성도 높은 사운드
entries.plain_en: slick, radio-ready sound quality with everything cleanly balanced

entries.music_theory_en: master bus (the final stereo output channel where whole-mix processing like glue compression is applied)
entries.plain_ko: 곡 전체 소리가 마지막으로 한데 모여 다듬어지는 최종 출력 단계
entries.plain_en: the final stage where the whole song's sound is glued and polished together
entries.llm_prompt: glued master bus processing, cohesive mix

entries.music_theory_en: spring reverb (spring-tank reverberation with boingy, metallic drip; classic guitar-amp/surf sound)
entries.plain_ko: 옛날 기타 앰프 특유의 '통-' 하고 튕기는 금속성 잔향
entries.plain_en: a boingy, metallic echo typical of vintage guitar amps
entries.llm_prompt: spring reverb, vintage boingy amp echo

entries.music_theory_en: clock-ticking (ticking-clock SFX or metronomic tick texture layered in the track)
entries.plain_ko: 시계 초침이 째깍거리는 소리를 효과음으로 넣은 것
entries.plain_en: the tick-tock of a clock used as a sound in the track
entries.llm_prompt: clock ticking sound, metronomic tick texture

entries.music_theory_en: water droplet (single water-drop SFX or drop-like plucky percussive timbre)
entries.plain_ko: 물방울이 '똑' 떨어지는 듯한 소리
entries.plain_en: a sound like a single water drop falling
entries.llm_prompt: water droplet sound, plucky drip texture

entries.music_theory_en: water droplets (multiple water-drip SFX or dripping plucky textures)
entries.plain_ko: 물방울이 여러 번 똑똑 떨어지는 듯한 소리 질감
entries.plain_en: sounds like water dripping repeatedly

entries.music_theory_en: hum (steady low-frequency tonal drone/noise, e.g. electrical hum or a sustained low murmur)
entries.plain_ko: 전기 기기나 낮은 웅웅거림처럼 일정하게 깔리는 저음의 웅웅 소리
entries.plain_en: a steady low droning buzz, like electrical hum
entries.llm_prompt: low hum drone, steady background buzz

entries.music_theory_en: stereo imaging (control of width and left-right placement of elements in the stereo field)
entries.plain_ko: 소리들을 좌우로 배치해 넓이와 위치감을 만드는 작업
entries.plain_en: shaping how wide and where sounds sit between left and right
entries.llm_prompt: precise stereo imaging, wide spatial placement

entries.music_theory_en: mono (monophonic single-channel audio; no stereo width, everything centered)
entries.plain_ko: 좌우 구분 없이 한 채널로만 들리는 모노 사운드
entries.plain_en: single-channel sound with no left-right separation

entries.music_theory_en: shutter (likely camera-shutter click SFX or gated stutter texture; ambiguous fragment)
entries.plain_ko: 카메라 셔터 '찰칵' 같은 효과음(또는 뚝뚝 끊기는 질감)으로 추정되는 표현
entries.plain_en: probably a camera-shutter click sound effect, or a chopped stuttering texture

entries.music_theory_en: slapback delay (single short echo ~60-150ms, classic rockabilly/50s vocal effect)
entries.plain_ko: 소리 바로 뒤에 한 번만 짧게 '탁' 되울리는 옛 로큰롤풍 에코
entries.plain_en: one quick single echo right after the sound, like 1950s rock'n'roll vocals
entries.llm_prompt: slapback delay, short single rockabilly echo

entries.music_theory_en: low-pass filter (attenuates frequencies above a cutoff, leaving lows; darkens/muffles the sound)
entries.plain_ko: 고음을 깎아내 소리를 어둡고 먹먹하게 만드는 필터
entries.plain_en: a filter that cuts the highs, making the sound darker and muffled

entries.music_theory_en: panned (positioned toward one side of the stereo field via pan control)
entries.plain_ko: 소리를 왼쪽이나 오른쪽 한쪽으로 치우쳐 배치한 것
entries.plain_en: the sound is placed toward the left or right speaker
entries.llm_prompt: panned to one side, off-center placement

entries.music_theory_en: high-pass filter (attenuates frequencies below a cutoff, removing lows; thins/brightens the sound)
entries.plain_ko: 저음을 깎아내 소리를 얇고 가볍게 만드는 필터
entries.plain_en: a filter that cuts the bass, making the sound thin and light

entries.music_theory_en: fuzz (extreme square-wave-like clipping distortion; woolly, buzzy 60s pedal tone)
entries.plain_ko: 벌이 윙윙대듯 보풀보풀하게 심하게 찌그러진 퍼즈 톤
entries.plain_en: a woolly, buzzing, heavily broken-up distortion like a 60s fuzz pedal

entries.music_theory_en: dripping (drip-like SFX texture, or descriptive of an effect-drenched sound; ambiguous fragment)
entries.plain_ko: 물이 뚝뚝 떨어지는 듯한 소리 질감(또는 이펙트가 뚝뚝 흐를 만큼 짙다는 묘사)
entries.plain_en: a dripping-water texture, or a sound soaked in effects

entries.music_theory_en: filter sweep (gradual movement of a filter cutoff across the spectrum, opening or closing the sound)
entries.plain_ko: 필터가 서서히 열리거나 닫히며 소리가 밝아졌다 어두워졌다 변하는 효과
entries.plain_en: the sound gradually opens up or closes down as a filter moves

entries.music_theory_en: clean production (uncluttered, low-noise, well-separated modern mix quality)
entries.plain_ko: 잡음 없이 각 소리가 깔끔하게 분리되어 들리는 정돈된 프로덕션
entries.plain_en: a tidy, noise-free mix where every sound is clear and separated

entries.music_theory_en: Auto-Tune (real-time pitch correction; at strong settings, the signature robotic vocal warble)
entries.plain_ko: 음정을 기계로 딱딱 맞춰 로봇처럼 매끈하게 들리는 오토튠 보컬 효과
entries.plain_en: vocals snapped to perfect pitch with that robotic Auto-Tune sound

entries.music_theory_en: clean (undistorted, low-noise timbre; e.g. clean guitar tone without overdrive)
entries.plain_ko: 찌그러짐이나 잡음 없이 맑고 깨끗한 소리
entries.plain_en: pure and clear, with no distortion or noise

entries.music_theory_en: distorted (clipped/saturated timbre with added rough harmonics)
entries.plain_ko: 거칠게 찌그러져 지글거리는 소리
entries.plain_en: gritty and crunchy, roughened by distortion

entries.music_theory_en: soft (low-intensity, gentle attack and subdued dynamics/timbre)
entries.plain_ko: 부드럽고 여린, 자극 없이 살며시 들리는 소리
entries.plain_en: gentle and quiet, easy on the ears

entries.music_theory_en: heavy (dense, powerful, often low-frequency-weighted and aggressive timbre)
entries.plain_ko: 묵직하고 강하게 짓누르는 듯한 소리
entries.plain_en: thick, powerful, and weighty sounding
entries.llm_prompt: heavy powerful sound, weighty low end

entries.music_theory_en: crisp (clear high-frequency detail with sharp, well-defined transients)
entries.plain_ko: 과자 부서지듯 또렷하고 바삭바삭하게 선명한 소리
entries.plain_en: sharp and clear with snappy, well-defined edges
entries.llm_prompt: crisp sharp transients, clear high end

entries.music_theory_en: breathy (audible breath/air noise mixed into the tone, especially in vocals or flutes)
entries.plain_ko: 숨소리가 섞여 바람이 스치듯 속삭이는 느낌의 소리
entries.plain_en: airy with audible breath, like a whispering voice
entries.llm_prompt: breathy airy vocals, audible breath texture

entries.music_theory_en: metallic (inharmonic overtone-rich timbre reminiscent of struck or resonating metal)
entries.plain_ko: 쇠붙이를 두드리거나 울릴 때 나는 듯한 차갑고 쨍한 소리
entries.plain_en: cold and clangy, like ringing metal

entries.music_theory_en: resonant (strong sustained resonance; ringing body or emphasized formant/filter peak)
entries.plain_ko: 울림통이 우렁우렁 울리듯 여운 있게 공명하는 소리
entries.plain_en: ringing and full, with a strong lingering resonance

entries.music_theory_en: lo-fi (low-fidelity aesthetic: band-limited, noisy, degraded texture used intentionally)
entries.plain_ko: 일부러 오래된 라디오처럼 지직거리고 뭉툭하게 만든 빈티지 음질
entries.plain_en: intentionally degraded, fuzzy old-radio sound quality
entries.llm_prompt: lo-fi degraded texture, dusty vintage quality

entries.music_theory_en: analog (warm, slightly saturated character of analog circuitry/tape, as opposed to clinical digital)
entries.plain_ko: 옛 장비 특유의 따뜻하고 살짝 뭉근한 아날로그 질감
entries.plain_en: warm and slightly rounded, like vintage tape and hardware
entries.llm_prompt: warm analog character, vintage tape saturation

entries.music_theory_en: shimmering (sparkling high-frequency movement; glistening, gently modulating brightness)
entries.plain_ko: 빛이 반짝이듯 고음이 잘게 일렁이며 빛나는 소리
entries.plain_en: sparkling and glistening, like light dancing on water

entries.music_theory_en: airy (open, light timbre with emphasized very-high 'air' band and spacious feel)
entries.plain_ko: 공기처럼 가볍고 탁 트여 산뜻하게 퍼지는 소리
entries.plain_en: light and open, as if there is air and space around the sound
entries.llm_prompt: airy open texture, light spacious highs

entries.music_theory_en: rounded (smooth timbre with softened attack and tamed high frequencies; no harsh edges)
entries.plain_ko: 모서리가 없이 둥글둥글 부드럽게 다듬어진 소리
entries.plain_en: smooth and mellow, with no sharp edges

entries.music_theory_en: compressed (dynamics-flattened timbre: dense, even, punchy from compression)
entries.plain_ko: 소리 크기 기복이 눌려 빽빽하고 단단하게 들리는 상태
entries.plain_en: dense and even, with the loud-quiet swings squashed flat

entries.music_theory_en: saturated (harmonically enriched by gentle overload of tape/tube/circuit; warm thickened tone)
entries.plain_ko: 테이프나 진공관을 적당히 밀어붙인 듯 배음이 더해져 뭉근하고 진한 소리
entries.plain_en: warmly thickened and enriched, like tape pushed just past its limit

entries.music_theory_en: thick (dense, full-bodied timbre with strong low-mid weight or heavy layering)
entries.plain_ko: 여러 겹 쌓인 듯 빽빽하고 살집 있는 두툼한 소리
entries.plain_en: full and dense, like many layers stacked together
entries.llm_prompt: thick layered sound, full-bodied low mids

entries.music_theory_en: sub-heavy (dominant sub-bass energy below ~60Hz; chest-shaking low end)
entries.plain_ko: 몸이 울릴 만큼 아주 낮은 초저음이 강하게 깔린 소리
entries.plain_en: loaded with deep bass you feel in your chest
entries.llm_prompt: sub-heavy bass, deep chest-rattling low end

entries.music_theory_en: low-end (the bass/sub-bass frequency region of the mix)
entries.plain_ko: 곡에서 베이스와 저음이 차지하는 낮은 음역대
entries.plain_en: the bass region of the sound, the deep low frequencies

entries.music_theory_en: glassy (clear, bright, smooth timbre with bell-like transparent highs, e.g. clean FM/Rhodes tones)
entries.plain_ko: 유리알처럼 맑고 투명하게 반짝이는 고운 소리
entries.plain_en: clear and glass-like, smooth transparent brightness

entries.music_theory_en: woody (warm, hollow, wood-resonant timbre typical of acoustic bodies, marimba, upright bass)
entries.plain_ko: 나무통이 울리는 듯 따뜻하고 구수하게 통통한 소리
entries.plain_en: warm and hollow like resonating wood
entries.llm_prompt: woody resonant timbre, warm acoustic body

entries.music_theory_en: nasal (midrange-honky timbre with emphasized ~800Hz-2kHz formants, pinched 'through the nose' quality)
entries.plain_ko: 코가 막힌 듯 콧소리 섞인 답답한 중음의 소리
entries.plain_en: pinched and honky, like singing through your nose

entries.music_theory_en: thin (lacking low-frequency body; lightweight, small-sounding timbre)
entries.plain_ko: 저음의 받침 없이 얇고 가냘프게 들리는 소리
entries.plain_en: lightweight and small, missing bass body

entries.music_theory_en: fuzzy (soft-edged, blurry saturated texture; woolly fuzz-like grain)
entries.plain_ko: 보풀이 인 것처럼 윤곽이 흐릿하고 지글거리는 소리
entries.plain_en: blurry and woolly, with a soft buzzing grain
entries.llm_prompt: fuzzy woolly texture, soft saturated grain

entries.music_theory_en: hollow (scooped midrange or tube-like resonance giving an empty, cavernous quality)
entries.plain_ko: 속이 텅 빈 통을 두드리는 듯 공허하게 울리는 소리
entries.plain_en: empty and tube-like, as if from inside a hollow container

entries.music_theory_en: hi-fi (high-fidelity: full-range, clean, detailed modern reproduction quality)
entries.plain_ko: 잡음 없이 또렷하고 풍부한, 음질 좋은 하이파이 사운드
entries.plain_en: clean, detailed, top-quality sound reproduction
entries.llm_prompt: hi-fi pristine sound, detailed full-range quality
